# tfcensus units

units lists the Terragrunt units and plain Terraform/OpenTofu root modules under each path,
with where each one keeps its state and which AWS account and region it manages.

A path with a terragrunt.hcl, root.hcl or terragrunt.stack.hcl anywhere below it is a Terragrunt
repo: terragrunt find lists its units. Any other path is searched for root modules, which are
directories whose .tf files have a backend or cloud block.

tfcensus evaluates remote\_state itself (the fast path). get\_aws\_account\_id there returns the
account of the default AWS credentials (AWS\_PROFILE, environment credentials or an instance role),
looked up once with sts:GetCallerIdentity and only when state needs it. With --render auto, units
the fast path can't evaluate, for example because they call run\_cmd or set iam\_role, go to
terragrunt render --json. Units that neither method resolves are listed with the reason. Without paths, units uses discovery.roots from
the config, or the working directory.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus units [paths...] [flags]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `paths` | no | yes |

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--filter` | terragrunt filter expression, passed to terragrunt find unchanged (repeatable) | string, repeatable |  |  |  |  |
| `--generate-stacks` | run terragrunt stack generate first, so units in stacks are listed (config discovery.generate\_stacks) | bool |  |  | [`discovery.generate_stacks`](/reference/config#discovery-generate-stacks) |  |
| `--md-max-chars` | cut Markdown output to this many characters at a row or section boundary; 0 means no limit | int | `60000` |  |  |  |
| `--out` | also write the report to a file as format=path (repeatable); format is one of plain, md or json | string, repeatable |  | `plain`: table without color<br>`md`: Markdown<br>`json`: JSON envelope for scripts |  |  |
| `--render` | when to use terragrunt render: auto, always or never (config discovery.render) | string | `auto` | `auto`: parse terragrunt.hcl, render the units it can't resolve<br>`always`: run terragrunt render for every unit<br>`never`: never run terragrunt render | [`discovery.render`](/reference/config#discovery-render) |  |

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Output formats

`--format` accepts `tty`, `plain`, `md`, `json`. Without it, the format is `tty` when stdout is a terminal and `plain` otherwise. Formats are described on the [global flags](/cli/global-flags) page.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 130 | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

All codes are listed on the [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes) page.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus units ~/src/infra/acme-live
tfcensus units --filter './live/prod/**' --format json
tfcensus units --render never --generate-stacks
```
